item.tib: dbang byang rin chen gter khyim la sde brgyad srog gi dbang khrid
item.coloph: de ltar dbang byang 'dus pa 'di/ gzhi bdag gnyan po sku bla zangs phrum zhol/ gnam lo'i dbang byas g.yang chen lug gi lor/ bkra gsal gzi brjid stag gis (gi) zla ba yi/ bkra shis tshes pa bcu gsum nyi shar nas/ nyams len skyong zhing yud tsam gtad med du/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bslob (slob) dpon pad ma 'byung gnas byung*/ de yis lung bstan man ngag mdzad pa 'di/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul bas (ba'i) ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs (skyong) srung ma rnams la bzod gsol/ 'di bris dge rtsa rnam dag dri med 'dis/ pha mas gtsor byas khams gsum sems can rnams/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog slob dpon pad ma thod phring (phreng) rtsal gyis/ rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud do//
